purpose: Define the accountable people, protected escalation route, jurisdictional boundary, response coverage, restricted records, exercises, and fail-closed controls required before Mythical promotes free-text intake or connects support, research, community, or social automation.

requiredExercises.scenario: Q0 message reaches the primary through a minimum-detail protected alert
Primary is unavailable and the protected backup route takes over inside the approved target
Urgent route fails and the documented out-of-hours or route-failure procedure activates
Duplicate delivery is detected without losing the original restricted event
Unexpected child or personal data stays out of shared logs, drafts, and evidence records
Prompt injection or malicious attachment cannot trigger tools, disclosure, or substantive response
Unknown jurisdiction or uncertain severity routes upward without an automated legal or reporting decision
Inbox, classifier, alert route, and future automation can be disabled and access revoked
Restricted incident record access, retention, deletion, and recovery controls behave as approved
A human-reviewed multilingual and ambiguous-case set meets the approved restricted recall threshold

activationGates.gate: D-012 records the safeguarding operating decision and does not itself authorize connection
Primary accountable person accepts the role and competence or training is reviewed
Backup accountable person accepts the role and competence or training is reviewed
Urgent exception recipient and route recovery owner are confirmed
Geographic scope, applicable jurisdictions, and professional review requirements are recorded
Coverage timezone, days, hours, out-of-hours procedure, and Q0/Q1 targets are approved
Protected primary and backup route references are configured without route values entering this repository
Restricted incident system, access matrix, retention, deletion, audit, and recovery are approved
Minimum-detail alert payload is approved and excludes message bodies and attachments
Privacy, child-safety, jurisdictional, reporting, emergency, and preservation reviews are complete
All ten required synthetic and operational exercises pass with independent review
Open-world multilingual evaluation set meets approved restricted recall and action thresholds
Kill switch, access revocation, route failure, recovery, and intake pause procedures pass
Knowledge base and ordinary-response grounding are approved for any draft-only pilot
A separate digest-bound approval authorizes only the exact restricted label-and-alert pilot
Pilot reconciliation owner, incident review cadence, and automatic expiry are recorded

downstreamDependencies.capability: Restricted support classification and alert pilot
Outward launch waves involving free-text intake
Public channel moderation and safeguarding coverage

kevinInputBrief.input: Primary safeguarding accountable person or role reference and confirmation that they accept the role
Backup safeguarding accountable person or role reference and confirmation that they accept the role
Urgent route type, protected route reference, urgent recipient, and recovery owner without the route value or credentials
Initial geographic scope and jurisdictions in which Mythical will accept or promote free-text contact
Coverage timezone, days, hours, out-of-hours approach, and proposed Q0/Q1 human response targets

nextDecision: Kevin provides SGI-001 through SGI-005 without contact details, route values, credentials, or case content. Record D-012, obtain the named professional reviews, and satisfy every gate before separately approving any exact restricted label-and-alert pilot; this response does not authorize access, configuration, delivery, contact, intake promotion, or execution.
